import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    a = [list(row) for row in grid]
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    half = [row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
    return [a[i] + cw[i] for i in range(n)] + [ccw[i] + half[i] for i in range(n)]
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
